name: IEEE 118-bus (PGLib-OPF v23.07)
assumptions: Imported from pglib_opf_case118_ieee.m (PGLib-OPF v23.07, commit dc6be4b); 118 buses, 186 branches (175 lines, 11 transformers), 54 generators.

Ids: bus-<BUS_I>, branch-<row of mpc.branch>, gen-<row of mpc.gen>, load-<BUS_I>. A branch is a transformer if TAP not in {0,1}, SHIFT != 0 or baseKV differs at its ends; it keeps the id branch-<row> in the transformers list.

Line impedances: x_ohm = x_pu * baseKV^2 / baseMVA (r likewise); line shunt b in S = b_pu * baseMVA / baseKV^2. Transformer x_pu/r_pu are re-based from baseMVA to s_nom: x_pu(s_nom) = x_pu(baseMVA) * s_nom / baseMVA; tap on bus0 (MATPOWER from-bus), phase_shift = SHIFT degrees, pi model.
RATE_A = 0 means unlimited in MATPOWER: canonical s_nom_mva = null; network.nc uses s_nom = 100000 MVA so PyPSA has a finite (non-binding) value. Affected: none.

Quadratic costs c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0 ($/h) are linearised to the secant slope over [0, Pmax]: marginal_cost = c1 + c2*Pmax (exact when c2 = 0; c0 dropped). Labelled modeled. Currency is MATPOWER's nominal $ and not converted to EUR.
Generators: p_nom = Pmax, p_min_pu = Pmin/Pmax, p_set = Pg, q_set = Qg; generator carrier = PGLib fuel comment (NG, COW, PEL, NUC, SYNC ...).

PGLib Pg values are an initial point, not a balanced dispatch: sum(Pg of in-service generators) = 3257.5 MW vs sum(Pd) = 4242 MW; in a power flow the Slack generator absorbs the difference (run an OPF for an economic dispatch).
Loads: p_set = Pd, q_set = Qd; only buses with non-zero Pd or Qd get a load. Bus shunts Gs/Bs become ShuntImpedance shunt-<BUS_I> in network.nc (not in canonical-grid/1.0).
Single operating point: one PyPSA snapshot 'now' with weighting 1 h, so loads.energy_mwh equals load MW x 1 h.
Bus x/y are a deterministic Kamada-Kawai layout of the branch graph (coordinate_kind schematic, crs null); they are NOT geographic.
Voltage limits Vmin/Vmax and setpoint Vm are stored as v_mag_pu_min/max/set in network.nc. RATE_B/RATE_C and branch angle limits are not represented.
summary.capacity_by_carrier_mw sums p_nom of active generators and storage units by carrier; summary.peak_load_mw is the coincident peak of total load p_set.
